record.issue_text: packages/core/EventManager.ts:517 — updateAllCalendarEvents awaits a credential.findUnique per calendar reference inside the loop, serializing N DB round-trips on every reschedule/update of a collective booking.

adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, updateAllCalendarEvents was changed to handle multiple calendar references by iterating `for (const reference of calendarReference)`. Inside that loop, when a matching in-memory credential is not found, it does an `await prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: reference.credentialId } ... })` before continuing. Because this await is inside the loop (and there is no batching or Promise.all around these DB reads), multiple references will cause serialized DB round-trips. This is a concrete, diff-introduced performance/scalability concern rather than a correctness defect.
